name: Deadmanoz
cooked:
It has also been a goal of mine since earlier this year to empirically test the “stale block disproportionally impacts smaller miners than large miners” theoretical finding (Propagation Delay and Mining Centralization: Modeling Stale Rates - Protocol Design - Delving Bitcoin), but I would be happy to have a BOSS participant pick this up as I can’t see myself prioritising this work before the BOSS program for 2027 starts (and completes).

I think the stale-blocks dataset is now suitable for this purpose (we have increased it from just over 1000 stales to just over 4000 stales in ~6 months), I am working on improving the mining-pools dataset as a background task and expect to have this largely finalised before BOSS starts in January.

I think the [stale-blocks](https://github.com/bitcoin-data/stale-blocks) dataset is now suitable for this purpose (we have increased it from just over 1000 stales to just over 4000 stales in ~6 months), I am working on improving the [mining-pools](https://github.com/bitcoin-data/mining-pools) dataset as a background task and expect to have this largely finalised before BOSS starts in January.
